directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, and purposeful spacing. Render one focused primary screen for a brand-new original JAKH ERP web application for construction contractors building towers from tender through handover. It must be exceptionally simple to navigate but retain rich source-linked business information. Never copy Odoo's layout. Input images are screenshots of the OLD application, attached as problem evidence and business/brand context ONLY: its overwhelming tall menu and repeated tabs are what the redesign must solve. Do not reproduce them. Preserve JAKH branding in plain type, no invented illustration/logo. Use only invented sample business data.
Target dimensions: 1440 x 1024 desktop application frame, full canvas no browser chrome or outside mockup framing. Natural proportions, readable 14–16px body text minimum, spacious comfortable rows, no clipped content. Exact current date is 28 October 2026, Wednesday; visible due dates must be plausible relative to that date.
Hard constraints: global destinations exactly My Work, Tenders, Projects, Company; current section Projects. Project destinations exactly Overview, Plan, Site, Buying, Costs & Contracts, Documents, Handover, in that order. Company legal context always visible: JAKH Contracting LLC; project Harbour Tower, Dubai; base currency AED. Multi-company selector is distinct from project navigation. Global search and user identity can be subtle utility controls. No expanded recursive module trees, no duplicate actions, no repeated tab bars inside details, no permanent chat sidebar, no giant grid of module tiles. AI exists only as small contextual Explain action with source support, not a destination. No fake claim that AI has approved anything.
Layout priority: spacing, grouping, alignment, typography, hierarchy on same surface first; simple dividers second; subtle tint only where useful; avoid cards nested inside cards, avoid shadow-heavy dashboards, no blanket card grids. Product fills base surface. Do not add panels, badges, metrics, charts or navigation just to advertise features. A focused primary use case, one primary action, at most two supporting content areas. All the ERP capabilities may exist offscreen. No decorative tower renders or photography. Use at most two fonts. This is a design preview with a tiny Sample data annotation.
Concept name: Clear desk.
Design a polished bright-white operational workspace with quiet forest-green accent, charcoal type, and restrained warm-gray rules. FOUR global destinations in a slim top horizontal bar. Below it a light quiet 208px project navigation rail with the SEVEN stable project destinations, Overview active. Company switcher is top right and visible; project title Harbour Tower at main top, subtitle Dubai · Delivery · 28 Oct 2026.
Main idea: a clean ordered daily action list rather than dashboard cards. Big heading 'Keep Harbour Tower moving.' One short status sentence 'Three decisions need attention today.' Main grouped list titled 'Needs your attention' with three spacious separated rows; readable text and owner/deadline. Row1: Purchase request PR-0264 · Reinforcement steel · Needed 02 Nov · EUR 36,000 / AED 144,000 estimated · 'Review request' the single prominent green button. Row2: NCR-018 · Level 12 concrete finish · Awaiting verification · Omar · Due today. Row3: VO-014 · Lobby layout revision · Cost review · Sara · Due 30 Oct. The latter rows have subtle row chevrons only.
One supporting section lower down, 'Cost outlook · AED', a short rule-generated finding above the numbers: 'Forecast is AED 0.6m above the revised budget.' Below, one quiet horizontal typographic strip: Revised budget 48.0m | Forecast final cost 48.6m | Cash paid 19.4m. Tiny source link 'View cost report' and quiet 'Explain' supporting action next to the finding; no charts, no metric cards. State 'As of 28 Oct · Illustrative figures'. Leave generous whitespace. Render as a usable sophisticated application, not a landing page.

Concept name: Project briefing.
A distinct warm editorial application: ivory-white background, deep ink navy and restrained copper-orange action accent, very light warm gray separators. Slim LEFT GLOBAL sidebar about 180px wide contains JAKH ERP wordmark and ONLY My Work, Tenders, Projects (active), Company. No other modules in that rail. At the top of main content a discreet company selector JAKH Contracting LLC and search. Below, project title Harbour Tower with subtitle Dubai · Delivery · Wednesday, 28 Oct 2026. The SEVEN project destinations form one simple horizontal text navigation under project title with Overview active. No other tabs.
Main interaction model: one clear short project briefing with progressive evidence; readable editorial scale, calm whitespace, no card grid. Heading 'Today at Harbour Tower'. A compact two-sentence status: 'Level 12 concrete work is awaiting quality verification. Review the steel purchase request to keep the next delivery on schedule.' Directly under it, one prominent copper button 'Review purchase request' with quiet supporting text 'PR-0264 · Reinforcement steel · EUR 36,000 / AED 144,000 estimated'.
Supporting area below: one simple vertical sequence titled 'Next on site', showing three dated rows with thin dividers: 'Today · Verify Level 12 concrete finish · Omar · NCR-018', '30 Oct · Review lobby layout change · Sara · VO-014', '02 Nov · Reinforcement steel needed on site · Procurement · PR-0264'. Avoid decorative timelines, do not imply programme calculations.
Second supporting area at bottom: compact 'Cost outlook · AED' plain section. At top of this section readable generated finding: 'Forecast is AED 0.6m above the revised budget.' Small text 'Revised budget 48.0m · Forecast final cost 48.6m · Cash paid 19.4m'; subtle link 'View cost report' and restrained contextual 'Explain'. Footnote 'As of 28 Oct · Sample data'. Do not add chart or photorealistic decoration. Readable, practical, exceptionally calm and premium typography; enough information that next action is obvious. This must look different in hierarchy and layout from an action-table workspace.

Concept name: Work in context.
Design an exceptionally clean, precise, modern white application with charcoal text, a restrained cobalt-blue action accent, subtle blue-gray backgrounds and fine rules. FOUR global destinations in horizontal top navigation, Projects active; global company selector JAKH Contracting LLC visible at top right. Under it the Harbour Tower project header, Dubai · Delivery · 28 Oct 2026, and ONE horizontal row of the seven project destinations, Overview active.
Main screen demonstrates in-place work WITHOUT losing project context. Two-column master-detail layout with a narrow 300px attention list on left and a generous open record detail pane on right. Do not put either in nested cards. Left heading 'Needs attention', just three separated list rows: PR-0264 Reinforcement steel (selected, awaiting approval), NCR-018 Level 12 concrete finish (verification due today), VO-014 Lobby layout revision (cost review due 30 Oct). Left footer quiet 'View all work'. No other visible work modules.
Right detail: small breadcrumb 'Buying / Purchase requests', then heading 'Reinforcement steel', subline 'PR-0264 · Awaiting approval · Requested by Mohammed Khan'. A thin neutral next-action line 'Next: Procurement manager review · Due today'. One prominent blue primary button 'Approve request' with subtle secondary 'Return for changes', no third primary action. Below large readable two-amount presentation: 'EUR 36,000' Vendor amount and 'AED 144,000' Company estimate. Adjacent rate footnote '1 EUR = 4.00 AED · 28 Oct 2026 · Illustrative rate'. Vendor 'EuroSteel Supplies', quote 'Q-781 · Valid until 04 Nov', location 'Level 13', cost item 'Concrete frame / Reinforcement'. Group these details cleanly as labels/value pairs without repeated tabs.
A small single line item row: 'Rebar, B500B' / '40 tonnes' / 'EUR 900 per tonne' / 'EUR 36,000'. Budget note beneath in very light blue: 'AED 200,000 available before this request. AED 56,000 remaining if approved.' This is a request approval only, NOT a purchase order, invoice or payment. Short subtle sentence 'Approval authorises sourcing; no order has been issued.'
At lower edge compact single history section 'Record history', two lines '28 Oct, 09:20 · Mohammed submitted revision 2' and '28 Oct, 08:45 · Quote Q-781 attached'. Small contextual 'Explain budget impact' with source label 'Quote + cost item', no chat bubbles. All data illustrative; Sample data footer. No dashboard metrics, no decorative art, no repeated tabs, no status flow maze. Calm pragmatic user experience, source-linked rich detail through simple readable groups.
